material.acceptance_criteria: The match clock appears once on screen, in the top-centre strip; the HUD line keeps its other fields.
material.description: After hud-team-strip-dota-compact, the team strip shows the match clock between the two kill counts (panels.lua:278-292). The HUD line at panels.lua:225-235 still shows the same clock. Dota shows the clock once, at the top centre. One of the two must go, and the strip is the one the reference shows.
material.subject: The game clock appears twice at the top, in the HUD line and in the new team strip
material.witness: Clock removed from the HUD line; kept on the strip. Codesearch (session verify-hud-clock-shown-twice, dispatch 1792862057875-5235-3c00c0d66aeec304): TEXT.hud.time no longer referenced; clock_text() called only at panels.lua:213 (definition) and 287 (team_tree). CI green on head 4b24d0bccd26cb723b9f83a473a5905a6ab121c3, which contains publish a21e626e. Witness is code-level; the 1280x720 screenshot was not taken.
material.witness_plan: Screenshot at 1280x720 in a match, confirming one clock. Run from a session other than the resolver.
